title: Back in the Pool
story: After a cold, Yasmin's doctor said she could swim again, but gently. She went to the pool on Saturday. For ten minutes she kicked slowly at the shallow end. Then she swam one easy length and rested. Her arms felt tired, so she did not race her friend. She left before the busy hour and wrote the time in a notebook.

vocabulary.definition: In a careful and soft way.
One swim from one end of a pool to the other.
Stopped activity in order to recover.
A small book for writing notes.
